name: World Cup Tracker LED Matrix Display

mentions.name: World Cup Tracker LED Matrix Display
mentions.description: This project is a World Cup tracker built into an LED matrix display, showing World Cup results, with ongoing work to make the display useful after the tournament ends.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a world cup tracker into an LED matrix display, and now I'm working on making it useful after the world cup
